title: Rethinking the AI Scientist: Interactive Multi-Agent Workflows for Scientific Discovery
reasoning: The paper includes a brief 'Ethical considerations' section (2.2) stating that ethical approval was not required due to the use of publicly available datasets. Section 4.1 discusses human-AI collaboration, governance, and 'human regulation and agent alignment' in the context of autonomous AI risks, but this is presented as architectural constraints and a practical aspect of system design, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component of the research.
